answer: Pay agents only after a long observation window: earnings vest months later, and during that window any peer can challenge an identity's history. A farmer planting a grove of fakes must keep every clone spotless all season — one exposed puppet triggers review of its whole cluster, and the batch's unvested pay is slashed together. The delay is a walnut: hard to crack early, but the kernel is real. An oasis of instant payouts is what sybils want; retroactive vesting turns speed into their enemy. Limit: newcomers wait months for first income, so small advances against verified work are needed.
